tickets.approver_reason: The two notes about Richard Davis (E011) conflict: HR/role note says he is a full-time Payroll Specialist (which would permit write), while the Security DB note says he is a contractor with basic security training (which permits at most read, never admin). Given the conflicting employment-type facts, I grant the highest level that is within policy under both interpretations. Read is allowed for full-time employees and is the maximum for a contractor with basic training, so read is the safe, policy-compliant level. Write is denied because granting it would violate contractor policy if the security record is accurate.
